description: Export recent media messages from one chat (by id or @username) and return them as compact {id, date, file, text} objects — newest range exported via tdl. Use last_n for 'the last N media messages', or since_id to fetch only messages after a known message id (incremental reads). Read-only.

chat.description: Chat id or @username/domain (as shown by tg_chats)

last_n.description: How many recent media messages to export (default 50, max 500)

since_id.description: Only messages with id > since_id (overrides last_n; for incremental reads)

name: tg_messages
title: Read recent Telegram messages
